mapper.select: SELECT id, video_id, current_step, status, attempts, max_attempts, last_error, owner_instance_id, heartbeat_at, payload, ext_info, created_at, updated_at FROM upload_task WHERE id = #{id}
SELECT id, video_id, current_step, status, attempts, max_attempts, last_error, owner_instance_id, heartbeat_at, payload, ext_info, created_at, updated_at FROM upload_task WHERE video_id = #{videoId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO upload_task (id, video_id, current_step, status, attempts, max_attempts, last_error, owner_instance_id, heartbeat_at, payload, ext_info, created_at, updated_at) VALUES ( #{id}, #{videoId}, #{currentStep, typeHandler=org.apache.ibatis.type.EnumTypeHandler}, #{status, typeHandler=org.apache.ibatis.type.EnumTypeHandler}, #{attempts}, #{maxAttempts}, #{lastError}, #{ownerInstanceId}, #{heartbeatAt}, #{payload, typeHandler=com.grace.platform.shared.infrastructure.persistence.typehandler.JsonMapTypeHandler}, #{extInfo, typeHandler=com.grace.platform.shared.infrastructure.persistence.typehandler.JsonMapTypeHandler}, #{createdAt}, #{updatedAt} )
mapper.update: UPDATE upload_task SET current_step = #{currentStep, typeHandler=org.apache.ibatis.type.EnumTypeHandler}, status = #{status, typeHandler=org.apache.ibatis.type.EnumTypeHandler}, attempts = #{attempts}, max_attempts = #{maxAttempts}, last_error = #{lastError}, owner_instance_id = #{ownerInstanceId}, heartbeat_at = #{heartbeatAt}, payload = #{payload, typeHandler=com.grace.platform.shared.infrastructure.persistence.typehandler.JsonMapTypeHandler}, ext_info = #{extInfo, typeHandler=com.grace.platform.shared.infrastructure.persistence.typehandler.JsonMapTypeHandler}, updated_at = #{updatedAt} WHERE id = #{id}
UPDATE upload_task SET status = 'RUNNING', owner_instance_id = #{instanceId}, heartbeat_at = NOW(), attempts = attempts + 1, updated_at = NOW() WHERE id = #{id} AND status = 'PENDING'
UPDATE upload_task SET heartbeat_at = NOW(), updated_at = NOW() WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.select: SELECT id FROM upload_task WHERE status = 'PENDING' AND updated_at < DATE_SUB(NOW(), INTERVAL #{orphanSeconds} SECOND) LIMIT 100
mapper.update: UPDATE upload_task SET status = 'PENDING', owner_instance_id = NULL, heartbeat_at = NULL, updated_at = NOW() WHERE status = 'RUNNING' AND heartbeat_at < DATE_SUB(NOW(), INTERVAL #{zombieSeconds} SECOND)
